**Report**

Open System > Information > Report a Problem, read the saved report, and drag
`~/Documents/eitr-problem-report-<time>.txt` here. It already leaves out your user
name, computer name and network addresses. Issues are public: remove anything
else you do not want to share. To report privately, email reports@eitr.info.
